about: A nullable scalar written with anyOf (chapter 2 § 2.3.2). Invalid: the package format review's reason is { "anyOf": [{ "type": "string" }, { "type": "null" }] }. Valid: { "type": ["string", "null"] }.
sentences: Format 'review' at /properties/reason writes a nullable string with anyOf; write it as "type": ["string", "null"].
